sessionSharing.notReadyToShare: Session is not ready to share yet
sessionSharing.linkModeDescription: Anyone with this link can join, no account required.
sessionSharing.userModeDescription: Share with a specific user who already has access to this host. If they do not have access yet, share the host with them first or use a link instead. Once shared, the session appears in their Connections tab.

permissionLevel.label: Permission level
permissionLevel.readOnlyDescription: Can watch the session live but cannot type or interact.
permissionLevel.readWriteDescription: Can type and interact with the session just like the owner.

sessionSharing.shareCreated: Session shared. It will appear in their Connections tab.
sessionSharing.userLacksHostAccess: That user does not have access to this host yet. Share the host with them first, or use a link instead.
sessionSharing.noActiveShares: No active shares for this session
sessionSharing.revokeConfirmDescription: Anyone using this share will lose access immediately.
sessionSharing.remoteDisplayUnavailable: Remote desktop is not available right now.

collab.persistentRoomHint: Persistent rooms stay listed after the meeting ends and can be reused.
collab.noRooms: No rooms yet. Create one to start a meeting.
collab.removeMemberDescription: {{name}} will lose access to this room immediately. Any active SSH viewer will be disconnected.
collab.takeOverDescription: {{name}} is presenting now. Taking over will disconnect everyone from that stage.
collab.emptyStage: Nobody is presenting. Take the stage to share a session.
collab.guestLinkOn: Guest link is on. Anyone with the link can watch the stage.
collab.rotateLinkDescription: The current link will stop working immediately. Connected SSH guests will be disconnected.
collab.disableLinkDescription: Anonymous SSH viewers will be disconnected immediately and the current link will stop working.
collab.endDescription: {{name}} will end for everyone and cannot be reopened.
collab.endPersistentDescription: The active presentation in {{name}} will stop. The room remains available for reuse.
collab.deleteDescription: {{name}} will be permanently deleted for everyone and cannot be undone.

globallyEnabled.description: Allow live terminal, RDP, VNC, and Telnet sessions to be shared instance-wide. Overrides every per-host sharing toggle when disabled.

allowSessionSharing.label: Allow Session Sharing
allowSessionSharing.description: Let live sessions on this host be shared via link or with other users

use.title: Share sessions and join rooms
use.description: Share live sessions by link or with other users, and create and join collaboration rooms.
